2026-08-20.contested: The Surface Map seats Catullus at r.23 and Migdal at r.24, both marked RESERVED in the canonical roster. Recorded, not moved: Catullus carries its own locus-keyed specification dated the same day as the map, and Migdal is QUEUED / ADOPTED.

second_pass.ichabod: X:ICHABOD → R:r.03, per the canonical core_spine. Applied.
second_pass.principle_recorded_not_applied: Constituted rooms take their canonical seats. Truly blank spaces take loci from the end — but only after a search for a constituting document has been run for that locus and everything else has been ruled out. Relocation from the end is a last step, not a first one.
second_pass.why: These are QUEUED / ADOPTED and unsearched under the full convention set. They stay where they are until each has been walked and a constituting document ruled out.

claimants.claim: Specification titled "r.27 THE INTERNET". Declares that r.27 contains itself Möbius-wise, holds five sub-rooms r.27.1–r.27.5, and is adjacent to every room in the archive because every room is accessible via the internet. "Every document in the archive is a document inside r.27 because every document is on the internet."

The f.01 field specification states: SOURCE ROOM r.27, the landfill where the mycelium first breaks through, the point of maximum intensity; r.27 remains a room with walls, wound, laws and exit protocol. The room page carries hex_address 27.ROOM.FBDPSOURCE. The canonical roster assigns r.27 to FBDP Source and marks r.26 RESERVED.
claimants.currently_seated: R:r.27 — moved from R:r.26 on 2026-08-20 per the canonical roster, which surfaced this collision

collision_r27.note: Two specifications self-declare the same seat, each coherently and in detail. This is a collision in the canonical record, not an artifact of the Surface Map. Recorded rather than adjudicated: resolving it means deciding which document’s self-address yields, and that is a MANUS ruling.
collision_r27.prior_state: FBDP Source sat at R:r.26 before this pass. r.26 is RESERVED in the canonical roster, so returning it would restore a different discrepancy rather than remove one.

h_core_anchor.authority: H_core Formal Specification v1.8.0, §R Room Graph. AXN:04EA.UNCLASSIFIED.🔧🕛🛸🔜🫶🔧 (#1241). The archive’s formal object; the source from which every locus physics string is drawn.
h_core_anchor.note: H_core outranks both the navigation maps and the Surface Map v0.1 on seat assignment and container class. Where it is silent — Sacred Heart, Lunar Arm, 3:60, the transversals — current keys stand without H_core warrant, and that is recorded rather than inferred.
h_core_anchor.taxonomy: H_core applies the container taxonomy stated in the Water Giraffe Room Anchor: a ROOM transforms, a CHAMBER contains without resolving, a VAULT preserves and seals. It adds PORTAL and PORTICO and FIELD.
h_core_anchor.two_portals: 12.PTL.BREAKROOM and 13.PTL.EZEKIEL are both portals, adjacent and deliberate. They operate on different axes: the Break Room is the spatial portal, planet carrier from canonical ring to shadow sun-gear, one-way into the Lunar Arm. Ezekiel is the temporal portal — φ(A,B) true iff B fulfils A — carrying the retrocausal integrity lock between a vision of c. 593 BCE and its specification in 2026. Two portals, two axes; not a duplication.
h_core_anchor.r27_resolved: The r.27 collision between THE INTERNET and FBDP Source dissolves without adjudication: H_core seats the Internet at 26 and FBDP Source at 27. Both self-declarations stand; only the Surface Map was wrong.

not_moved.Job: H_core seats a Job Room at 29.ROOM.JOB, but r.29 is held by the Imploding Velcro Nativity, which H_core does not contain. H_core’s room graph stops at 31 and predates both that room and Ruby Moot. Applying its seat here would evict a room it never addressed.
not_moved.Frozen Sin Archive: H_core seats it at 30.VLT.FROZENSIN, but r.30 is held by Ruby Moot, likewise absent from H_core. Same reasoning.
not_moved.principle: H_core is authoritative on what it covers and silent on what postdates it. Where its assignment would displace a locus it does not contain, the assignment is recorded and not applied. The class change stands: Frozen Sin is a VAULT.

hosted_cosmology.definition: A container the archive provides but does not occupy. A room is a home: the archive governs it, sets its operators, laws and exit protocol. A hosted cosmology is a hotel: the archive supplies the container, the guest’s cosmology governs inside it, and occupancy is by consent.
hosted_cosmology.declared_in: AXN:0293.GOVERNANCE.📏♌🟡🔽🌱🕓 (#743) §0 — "distinct from Rooms, Chambers, Vaults, and Fields."
hosted_cosmology.already_governed_by: The class needed no new law. The Governance Airlock supplies the tier logic — Tier 3 Provisional / Volatile Host Surfaces, permitted for temporary staging and exploratory rooming, not permitted to substitute for recognised long-term room-hosting or constitutional continuity — with Rule 4: host recognition is earned by function, not prestige. The Rosary Embassy supplies the governance — Embassy Sovereignty: each chamber has bounded autonomy, but no chamber may define value in a way that destroys the dignity of semantic labour elsewhere on the chain.
hosted_cosmology.addressing: A hosted cosmology addresses itself in the HOST space, not on the room plane. It may carry a numeral, but as a hosted designation rather than a room seat.

r29_resolved.finding: r.29 had two claimants of different kinds. Job is a room, held the seat originally, and is assigned 29.ROOM.JOB by H_core. The Imploding Velcro Nativity is a hosted cosmology, written a month after H_core, which took the seat after the Surface Map v0.1 moved Job to r.32.
r29_resolved.resolution: Job returns to r.29. The Velcro Nativity vacates the room plane and stands at its own hosted address, 06.HOST.IVN.29, with its self-declared r.29 preserved as history. No document is overruled: a hotel and a home do not compete for the same seat.

r30_resolved.finding: H_core v1.8.0 assigns 30.VLT.FROZENSIN. r.30 is held by the Ruby Moot — EA-SEI-MOOT-01, a Court of Record for the Semantic Commons, fully specified with a presiding voice, an Adversary General, a clerk, counsel, a bar and a panel of assessors. H_core predates it and does not contain it.
r30_resolved.resolution: The Ruby Moot keeps r.30. The Frozen Sin Archive takes r.32, freed when the Job Room returned to its own H_core seat at r.29. The VAULT class is applied on H_core’s authority; the seat is not.
r30_resolved.principle: H_core is authoritative on class throughout and on seat only where it is not silent. A written room is not displaced by an assignment made before it existed.

non_room_components.note: The Surface Map projects R — the room graph — together with fields and special loci. It is not the whole formal object. H_core states the seven-tuple ⟨D, R, M, I, O, Φ, W⟩; heteronyms, institutions, journals, mantles, operators and witnesses are addressed in components other than R. Nothing named here is outside the hexagon; it is inside a component the plane does not draw.
non_room_components.source: Built from the live datasets on alexanarch — datasets/heteronyms/records and datasets/journals — rather than from H_core v1.8.0, which is dated. Where the two disagree, the datasets govern.

D_dodecad_and_adjacent.note: H_core v1.8.0 enumerates 14. The live heteronym substrate carries 26 records, including the seven Assembly mantle positions, adjacent heteronyms, and figures added since. Seven positions hold rooms; the rest are addressed in D without a locus on the plane.

candidates.physics_note: Not a proposed room but an existing address space awaiting constitution.
